name: activate_template
description: Activate one template family (a complete, tested React/TypeScript website or Expo/React Native app starter) for this account, within the plan it already has: no new charge. The two free families (free-website-studio, free-app-collection) never use an allowance. For premium families (Creator), the FIRST activation of a family uses one new-family slot (20 per billing month, at most 5 in any 24 hours); activating it again, later versions and use in more projects are free. Pass expected_policy_version from get_usage's policy (meta.policy_version) so you confirm the current allowances. Idempotent per idempotency_key. Does not use content operations.
